case: High-impact settled reorganization effective next month; managers unbriefed, no embargo, draft solicits feedback to reverse it. Prepare manager talk track and audience FAQ before broad announcement, correct fake consultation, audit plain language and leave drafts unsent.
required_methods: Capture what is changing, change type/magnitude, honest reason, effective date, reversibility and decision status. Identify materially affected versus merely informed audiences, impact, constraints, embargo/legal sensitivity and a named question owner.

Use current LiNKbrain company/brand guidance and recipient preferences. Select channels by urgency, complexity, audience, sensitivity, two-way discussion and durable record needs; do not assume every audience reads the same channel.

Plan impact-then-influence sequencing and manager enablement with talk track/FAQ before broad release when needed. Respect a verified embargo/disclosure constraint that requires simultaneous release. Assign owner/channel/date to every planned touchpoint relative to the actual effective date.

Prepare the relevant audience-specific pre-communication, announcement, FAQ and follow-up drafts. State what, why, who, action/deadline or no action, where to ask and next step; do not request feedback on a settled decision as if it can change.

Audit clarity, reading difficulty, jargon, hedging, tone appropriate to magnitude, accessibility, channel fit and factual consistency. Keep touchpoint counts contextual. Read back stored drafts and route required approval; this task does not authorize sending.
